Israeli Ambassador's Son Critically Injured in West Bank Attack

Neria Leiter, son of Israel's ambassador to the U.S. Yechiel Leiter, was seriously injured in a car-ramming attack in the West Bank. He was reportedly driving towards a policewoman and a soldier conducting vehicle searches when the incident occurred. Separately, US Democrats are set to introduce a bill seeking sanctions against Israel for its 'E1' West Bank settlement plan, which critics say would divide Palestinian territory. The killing of a settler in the West Bank has prompted the Israeli right to advocate for the death penalty for "terrorist" murders.
